title: Resolve Open Question 7 by naming the operator-facing surface for the per-category pass record
text: Resolve Open Question 7 by naming the operator-facing surface for the per-category pass record. AC1 and AC20 require observable records, but logs, check-run output, benchmark output, or multiple surfaces have materially different product visibility and verification contracts.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in e8485e6, the next commit. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Spec PR counted in scope: Ronda reviews spec PRs and reports no findings. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
